E0138

An operation used on a nominal `distinct` type whose operation bundles don't grant it (D-CAPBUNDLE1)

What

An operation used on a nominal `distinct` type whose operation bundles don't grant it (D-CAPBUNDLE1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0138

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0138: tests/ui/capbundle_operation_not_granted.stderr.

Error [E0138]: `Usd` doesn't support string interpolation
  --> tests/ui/capbundle_operation_not_granted.jet:5:13
    |
  5 |     print("{a}")
    |             ^
 Why: a nominal type only gets the operations its operation bundles grant; `Usd` has no operation bundles
 Fix: add `#Printable` before the declaration, or convert to the base type first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0138
